purpose: Register the two fixed PC session policy parameters and grant the API their exact versioned configuration persistence operations.
lockImpact: Two bounded catalog inserts and privilege metadata locks; no existing configuration or session rows are rewritten.
dataImpact: Adds immutable parameter definitions with defaults of one PC session and a five-second revocation target. No activation is created.
backfill: Not required; unresolved parameters use their registered defaults.
recovery: Retain the immutable definitions, releases and activations during application rollback. Older applications continue using startup configuration.
forwardFix: Append a later migration or publish a new parameter value; never edit this migration after application.
